notes: The first branch ends at إسماعيل بن كثير, whom the text calls «وكان يكنى أبا هاشم»; the two names are not merged, and the text writes no names for that branch after the ح, so it is read as ending there.
The second branch ends at «عن أبيه», an unnamed relation of Asim: the Companion is not identified by the text.
